en:
No one wants more victims...
Maybe Gonta doesn't understand that?

It'll be meaningless if we're saved, 
but Gonta loses himself.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?

I should probably use my magic to keep an
eye on him so he doesn't get out of control.

Shuichi, if you're not doing anything, 
you should help...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko said she would use magic, but we
ended up just stalking Gonta...
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
